02 · What sets the unit apart

Three decisions behind every unit.

01

Stator wound in house

A laminated steel stator, wound on our own machines, so every winding matches the job.

02

N52H in every motor

N52H magnets in every rotor. The bell is aluminium, investment cast or CNC turned, never 3D printed.

Our own controller

Own ESC hardware and firmware, tuned with the motor it drives.

07 · Stator cores

Two ways to build a stator: lamination and SMC.

Laminated steel · SMC, side by side Drag to turn
In production

Laminated steel

  • Thin insulated steel sheets, stacked and bonded
  • High permeability and saturation: the proven choice for our drone motors
  • Flux runs in the plane of the sheets
In development

SMC: soft magnetic composite

  • Insulated iron powder, pressed to net shape in one piece
  • Flux can run in 3D: taller pole shoes, rounded teeth, shorter end turns
  • Low eddy-current loss at high frequency, little scrap
Core technology

10 · Machines · Inner winding

Inner winding: wire laid from inside the bore.

A needle travels through the stator bore and lays wire into slots that open inward, tooth by tooth, while the fixture indexes the stator round.

  • 01

    For inward-slot stators

    Stators whose teeth point to the centre, as in inrunner and fan motor designs.

  • 02

    Tension held constant

    Wire runs from the spool through a tensioner, so every turn sits the same.

  • 03

    Repeatable

    Turns and layers set on the touch screen, the same on the first stator and the last.

Inner winding machine Drag to turn
Winding, in house
11 · Machines · Outer winding

Outer winding: for every outrunner we build.

Our drone motors spin the bell outside the stator, so their teeth face outward. Flyer heads wrap each tooth from outside as the stator indexes.

  • 01

    Every drone stator

    2806, 4006, 4215 and the X6 and X8 class units.

  • 02

    Matched windings

    Windings set for each partner's drone, not one size for all.

  • 03

    Several at once

    Multi-spindle heads wind stators side by side.

Outer winding machine Drag to turn
Winding, in house
12 · Machines · Magnet insertion

Magnets set by machine, not by hand.

N52H magnets are loaded into the rotor bell by machine, evenly spaced, in the right polarity and seated to the same depth, pole after pole.

  • 01

    Exact spacing

    Every magnet in its place, so the motor runs smoothly.

  • 02

    Right polarity

    North and south alternate correctly, every time.

  • 03

    Same every bell

    Repeatable from the first rotor to the thousandth.

Magnet insertion machine Drag to turn
Magnets, in house
13 · Machines · Rotor balancing

Every rotor balanced before it flies.

The rotor spins on the machine while sensors measure its vibration. The screen shows where, and how much, to correct.

  • 01

    Smoother flight

    Less vibration reaching the frame and the flight controller.

  • 02

    Longer bearing life

    Less load on the bearings, hour after hour.

  • 03

    Checked, not assumed

    Each rotor measured, corrected and measured again.

Rotor balancing machine Drag to turn
Balancing, in house
